scope: Source-bound contact-law and saved-response summary for the six current packer-free analysis-v2 cases. This is a conditional analytical evaluation, not structural acceptance.

separate_member_faces.timber_face_contact: Unilateral normal penalty, force = stiffness * max(Bq, 0), stiffness = trimmed reference cell area * 1.0 N/mm^3 bedding.
separate_member_faces.flange_contact: Unilateral normal-only angle-to-wood penalty, area-weighted from the declared 40000 N/mm flange prior; no tangential force, friction, tensile adhesion, or point couple.
separate_member_faces.panel_contact: Unilateral normal penalty with 2.0 N/mm^3 declared panel bedding. Panel rows are excluded from the sawn-wood comparison below.
separate_member_faces.wood_to_wood_and_side_cleat: Contact between separate timber analysis bodies is normal-compression only. Tangential transfer is assigned to modeled bolt/shaft bearing, end capture, member operators, and other declared connection springs; the face itself supplies no shear or friction.

other_transfer.bolts: Timoshenko shaft elements with radial-clearance bearing springs at wood/steel receivers and separate one-sided head/nut axial captures. These are analytical springs; delivered bearing, preload, washer pressure/prying, shaft bending qualification, and rotational restraint remain unresolved.
other_transfer.floor: Four declared hosts use assumed XY no-slip penalties; floor friction and capacity are not verified.

law.paired_plywood_cleats: Each paired two-leaf cleat remains one perfect-composite analysis body under the existing perfect-bond assumption. The separate-member face-contact finding neither removes nor qualifies that internal adhesive bond.
law.finite_motion: The saved normal displacement is a fixed-reference first-order Bq projection. It is not a finite-kinematic gap, surface recontact, or physical penetration result; fitting body-load heel offsets are not added to contact gaps.
law.contact_tension_tangential_and_friction: Contact compression scalars are nonnegative by construction; saved action vectors have at most 1.61e-13 N tangential numerical residual from their declared normals. This does not establish zero physical tension or shear. A friction ratio is undefined because no face tangential/friction law is present.

contact_footprint.basis: Cells partition trimmed shared-face patches extracted from the current prepared finished-body BReps; they are not gross rectangular member-face areas. This is the nominal model-geometry footprint, not a measurement of actual lumber fit, flatness, or bearing strength.
contact_footprint.side_cleat_left_and_right: Each trimmed patch is 32816.5151 mm^2 with 18 cells; each direct-cell area sum is 32816.5151 mm^2 and closes to the patch within 2.2e-6 mm^2. Cell centroids are on the trimmed patch and have occupied inward-material probes.

saved_six_case_contact_actions.meaning: Values are maximum single-cell compression actions under the declared penalties. They are not total pair forces, patch resultants, or physical demand bounds.

conditional_sawn_wood_mean_pressure_scre.method: For non-panel face-contact cells only, divide saved single-cell compression by the current trimmed BRep reference cell area. Evaluate a sawn member only when the prepared contact normal is perpendicular to that member's current grain axis (absolute dot <= 1e-8). Exclude plywood without assigning it Fc and skip oblique/parallel grain directions.

reference.basis: Conditional dry DF-L No. 2 reference; CD = 1, Cb = 1, no Cg; no plywood value assigned.
reference.scope: NDS 3.10 mean-pressure comparison only; no pressure peak or complete bearing/joint pass is claimed.

limitations: Penalty stiffness and contact force distribution are unmeasured; these conditional mean cell pressures are not physical peaks or bounded demands.

This does not establish the delivered wood species, grade, service condition, actual contact, or bearing resistance. No bearing-strength pass, force interaction, complete joint acceptance, or design release follows.
The current perfect-bond plywood-cleat operator remains an independent unqualified analytical assumption.

evidence_bindings.six_saved_fields: SHA256s and contact-action extraction are bound by ignored_source_audit.output_pins.field_sha256.
